models.name: sur-ron light bee x
models.description: Electric dirt bike built from scratch in Blender. 19" spoked wheels with knobby tyres, upside-down forks, coil-over shock, a 130-link chain driven by the rear wheel. Press play for the ride: launch, suspension over the whoops, lean through the bends and the jump, played in place.

models.name: sur-ron light bee x · orange
models.description: The same Light Bee X in the black and orange graphics kit: printed orange, white and grey graphics on the side covers, rear covers and head stock, a round LED headlight on fork brackets, a bronze shock spring and a gold chain. Same ride animation.
